Scoped checks passed for manifest dependencies, dependency levels, precheck, proof contracts, source fetches and content policy. `depcheck` found no errors and 11 contextual-link warnings. `proof-layout` found two failures: the counterexample arguments are numbered under `Verification`, not under `Counterexample`. The coverage checklist also reports one low-yield warning because the owner directed us to retain already-published carriers.

The review disposition is 35 ready and 8 escalated. The escalations cover six claims depending transitively on `thm-geometric-series`, whose proof uses `1 > 0` without declaring `cor-of-one-positive`, and the two counterexample layout failures. The owner repair details are in the notes.

I could not write the required machine readiness records: both `step1-decisions check` and a `record` attempt fail because the run snapshot finds `lem-it-quantum-relative-entropy-support-regularization` duplicated in batches 21 and 22. I left those unassigned manifests untouched. The owner must reconcile that duplicate before batch 2 records can be generated.
